description: Take down the mocks a repository serves, freeing its simulation slot. Runs the workflow with `delete: true`, which needs the workflow_dispatch trigger this bridge writes; a repo whose own workflow lacks it cannot be torn down this way, and the result says so. Pass `delete_repo: true` to also delete the repository itself, which is permanent and needs the `delete_repo` scope, so confirm with the user before using it.

delete_repo.description: Also delete the repository. Permanent. Ask first.

name: unpublish_from_github
